name: @pipeworx/mcp-newsdata

tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: Get news headlines and articles — world news, breaking news, and business/financial/stock-market news. Filter by keyword, country (2-letter, e.g. "us"), category (business, technology, politics, sports, health, science), and language. IMPORTANT: for stock-market / financial-market / economy / "world market news" questions, ALWAYS pass category: "business" — it returns real market-news outlets and filters out low-quality SEO/crypto-promo articles. Returns article title, description, link, source, publish date, category, and country. Paginate via the nextPage token. WITHOUT from_date/to_date this covers only roughly the LAST 48 HOURS (NewsData.io's rolling "latest" feed) — asking about an older event with no date window silently returns today's unrelated articles instead of an empty result. For a PAST date range, pass from_date/to_date (YYYY-MM-DD): this routes to NewsData.io's archive endpoint, which requires a plan tier above the shared platform key's default — if the account cannot serve it, the call returns a `filter_gap` field naming the unsupported window instead of silently substituting the latest 48h. Examples: latest_news({ query: "stock market", category: "business" }) for current world market news; latest_news({ query: "election", country: "us", category: "politics" }); latest_news({ query: "Houthi Yemen attack", from_date: "2026-08-01", to_date: "2026-08-15" }) for an August event.

query.description: Keywords to search news articles for. Every term is AND-ed — each word must appear in the article — so use 1-3 distinctive keywords ("NMPA approval biotech", "AI chips") rather than a full phrase; "Chinese biotech out-licensing deals NMPA approvals" returns 0 results while "NMPA Chinese biotech" returns articles.

country.description: 2-letter country code to filter news by, e.g. "us", "gb", "in"

category.description: News category, e.g. "business", "technology", "politics", "sports", "health", "science". OMIT unless confident — a wrong category guess returns 0 results (e.g. drug-approval and pharma-industry stories are categorized "business", not "health").

language.description: Language code to filter news by, e.g. "en", "es", "fr"

from_date.description: Start of a PAST date window, YYYY-MM-DD. Supplying this (or to_date) switches the call from the 48h "latest" feed to NewsData.io's archive endpoint, which may require a higher plan tier than the shared platform key has — if so, the response carries `filter_gap` naming the unsupported window rather than silently returning current articles.

to_date.description: End of a PAST date window, YYYY-MM-DD. See from_date.

page.description: nextPage token returned from a prior call, to fetch the next page of results

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own NewsData.io API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: crypto_news
tools.description: Get the latest cryptocurrency news headlines and articles. Filter by keyword, coin ticker(s) (e.g. "btc,eth"), and language. Returns article title, description, link, source, publish date, category, and country. Example: crypto_news({ coin: "btc,eth", query: "etf" })

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search crypto news for, e.g. "etf", "halving"

coin.description: Comma-separated coin ticker(s) to filter by, e.g. "btc,eth"

language.description: Language code to filter news by, e.g. "en", "es", "fr"

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own NewsData.io API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: news_sources
tools.description: List available global news sources. Filter by country (2-letter), category, and language. Returns source id, name, url, category, country, and language — useful for discovering which outlets cover a given region or topic. Example: news_sources({ country: "us", category: "technology" })

country.description: 2-letter country code to filter sources by, e.g. "us", "gb"

category.description: News category to filter sources by, e.g. "business", "technology"

language.description: Language code to filter sources by, e.g. "en", "es"

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own NewsData.io API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-newsdata forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the newsdata pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
